items.name: emoji-picker
items.title: Emoji Picker
items.description: An emoji picker and reaction row with shortcodes, skin tones, custom emoji, and replaceable search, built on @brianhung/emoji-picker-react.

:root.--emoji-font-family: "Emoji Picker Apple", "Segoe UI Emoji", "Segoe UI Symbol", "Segoe UI", "Apple Color Emoji", "Twemoji Mozilla", "Noto Color Emoji", "EmojiOne Color", "Android Emoji"

items.name: emoji-picker-popover
items.title: Emoji Picker Popover
items.description: The emoji picker in your shadcn/ui popover, for the Base UI (default) and Radix bases. A trigger opens it, and a pick closes it. For --base aria, use emoji-picker-popover-aria.

items.name: emoji-picker-popover-aria
items.title: Emoji Picker Popover (React Aria)
items.description: The emoji picker in your shadcn/ui popover, for the React Aria base (--base aria). A trigger opens it, and a pick closes it.

items.name: emoji-reaction-bar
items.title: Emoji Reaction Bar
items.description: A row of reaction buttons as a React Aria toolbar: arrows, Home and End move focus, and the pointer carries it once focus is inside.

items.name: emoji-prosemirror
items.title: Emoji ProseMirror
items.description: Shortcode suggestions as a ProseMirror plugin, without React. It finds the :query, handles the keys, and replaces the query with the chosen emoji.

items.name: emoji-suggestion-menu
items.title: Emoji Suggestion Menu
items.description: The shortcode typeahead menu for any EmojiTypeahead, positioned at the caret with EmojiSuggestions. The Tiptap and Lexical items render it.

items.name: emoji-tiptap
items.title: Emoji Tiptap
items.description: Shortcode typeahead for a Tiptap 3 editor: the useTiptapEmojiTypeahead hook on the ProseMirror plugin, the EmojiSuggestionMenu component, and an EmojiNode for custom emoji.

items.name: emoji-lexical
items.title: Emoji Lexical
items.description: Shortcode typeahead for a Lexical editor: the useLexicalEmojiTypeahead hook, the EmojiTypeaheadPlugin component, and an EmojiNode for custom emoji.
